name: Indonesia
licenseInformation: Indonesia is © Splotter Spellen. This implementation is a fan port for personal use.
implementationNotes: Implements the 2009 English rulebook for 2–5 players on the second-edition board. Each player has one Hull track, as in the 2009 rules, so the board's 'Hull Company' row is not used. You choose the ship each sale sails on, but it then takes the cheapest route along that ship's line that uses it; the book lets you choose the whole route. Ownership huts are not limited to the box's 8 per player.
artist: Jan Lipiński, Ynze Moedt, Jeroen Kesselaar
description: Build the economy of the Indonesian archipelago: start rice, spice, rubber and oil plantations and shipping lines, sell goods to growing cities, and buy out your rivals in merger auctions. Whoever has the most money when era C ends wins.
